questions.question: He is ______ honest man.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a silent 'h' and vowel sound /ɒ/, taking indefinite article 'an'.

questions.question: She is ______ European citizen.
questions.explanation: 'European' begins with consonant sound /j/ (yoo-ro-pean), taking article 'a'.

questions.question: Copper is ______ useful metal.
questions.explanation: 'Useful' begins with consonant sound /j/, taking article 'a'.

questions.question: He graduated from ______ university in London.
questions.explanation: 'University' starts with consonant glide /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: It was ______ one-man show.
questions.explanation: 'One' begins with consonant sound /w/ (wun), taking article 'a'.

questions.question: He is ______ M.A. in English.
questions.explanation: Abbreviation 'M.A.' begins with vowel sound /em/, taking article 'an'.

questions.question: His father is ______ M.L.A.
questions.explanation: 'M.L.A.' starts with vowel sound /em/, taking article 'an'.

questions.question: She lodged ______ F.I.R. with the police.
questions.explanation: 'F.I.R.' begins with vowel sound /ef/, taking article 'an'.

questions.question: He is ______ S.P. of the district.
questions.explanation: 'S.P.' starts with vowel sound /es/, taking article 'an'.

questions.question: The patient was admitted to ______ ICU.
questions.explanation: 'ICU' begins with vowel sound /aɪ/, taking article 'an'.

questions.question: ______ Ganga is a sacred river.
questions.explanation: Names of holy/major rivers always take the definite article 'The'.

questions.question: ______ Himalayas are situated in the north of India.
questions.explanation: Mountain ranges take the definite article 'The' ('The Himalayas').

questions.question: Mount Everest is ______ highest peak in the world.
questions.explanation: Superlative adjectives ('highest') always take definite article 'the'.

questions.question: ______ Mount Everest is located in Nepal.
questions.explanation: Individual mountain peaks (Mount Everest, Mount Abu) do NOT take 'The'.

questions.question: He plays ______ flute very well.
questions.explanation: Musical instruments take the definite article 'the' when playing them.

questions.question: Can you play ______ guitar?
questions.explanation: Musical instruments take 'the' ('play the guitar').

questions.question: ______ Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
questions.explanation: Names of oceans always take 'The' ('The Pacific Ocean').

questions.question: ______ Sahara is a vast desert.
questions.explanation: Names of deserts take 'The' ('The Sahara').

questions.question: He reads ______ Hindu newspaper daily.
questions.explanation: Names of newspapers take definite article 'The' ('The Hindu').

questions.question: ______ Bible is the holy book of Christians.
questions.explanation: Names of sacred scriptures take 'The' ('The Bible', 'The Quran', 'The Gita').

questions.question: The train runs at sixty miles ______ hour.
questions.explanation: Expressions of rate/speed take indefinite article: 'sixty miles an hour'.

questions.question: Apples are sold at fifty rupees ______ kilo.
questions.explanation: Expressions of price per unit take 'a kilo'.

questions.question: Kalidasa is ______ Shakespeare of India.
questions.explanation: When a proper noun is used as a standard of comparison, it takes definite article 'the'.

questions.question: Kashmir is ______ Switzerland of India.
questions.explanation: Proper noun used as a descriptive common noun takes 'the'.

questions.question: He is ______ honorary secretary of the club.
questions.explanation: 'Honorary' has silent 'h' and vowel sound /ɒ/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: She bought ______ umbrella yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Umbrella' begins with short vowel sound /ʌ/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: This is ______ heir to the vast estate.
questions.explanation: 'Heir' has a silent 'h' and is pronounced /eə/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: She is ______ heiress of a royal family.
questions.explanation: 'Heiress' begins with silent 'h', taking 'an'.

questions.question: Gold is ______ precious metal.
questions.explanation: Material nouns ('Gold') take no article in general sense, but predicate complement takes 'a precious metal'.

questions.question: ______ gold mined in Kolar is of high quality.
questions.explanation: When an uncountable/material noun is particularized by a clause ('mined in Kolar'), it takes 'The'.

questions.question: Honesty is ______ best policy.
questions.explanation: Superlative degree 'best' requires 'the'.

questions.question: ______ honesty of the clerk was praised by all.
questions.explanation: Abstract noun particularized by a modifying phrase takes 'The'.

questions.question: He goes to ______ church every Sunday to pray.
questions.explanation: Institutions (church, school, hospital, prison) take NO article when visited for primary purpose.

questions.question: The carpenter went to ______ church to repair the door.
questions.explanation: When visited for secondary purposes other than prayer, 'church' takes 'the'.

questions.question: The criminal was sent to ______ prison.
questions.explanation: 'Prison' for serving a sentence takes no article.

questions.question: His brother went to ______ prison to meet him.
questions.explanation: Visiting prison for meeting takes 'the'.

questions.question: Breakfast is ______ first meal of the day.
questions.explanation: Ordinal numbers ('first', 'second', 'third') take definite article 'the'.

questions.question: We had ______ delicious breakfast this morning.
questions.explanation: Names of meals take article 'a' when preceded by an adjective ('a delicious breakfast').

questions.question: I usually take ______ dinner at 8 PM.
questions.explanation: Regular meals in general sense take no article.

questions.question: ______ dog is a faithful animal.
questions.explanation: A singular countable noun representing the entire species takes 'The' (or 'A').

questions.question: ______ cow is a sacred animal.
questions.explanation: 'The cow' represents the whole class of cows.

questions.question: Man is ______ mortal.
questions.explanation: 'Man' used in general sense for mankind takes NO article.

questions.question: He was elected ______ President of the committee.
questions.explanation: Titles of unique public offices following verbs like 'elect', 'appoint', 'make' take no article.

questions.question: They appointed him ______ chairman.
questions.explanation: Complement of 'appoint' takes no article.

questions.question: ______ sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: Unique celestial bodies take 'The' ('The sun', 'the moon', 'the earth').

questions.question: The earth revolves around ______ sun.
questions.explanation: Unique celestial bodies take 'the'.

questions.question: He is ______ taller of the two brothers.
questions.explanation: Comparative degree with 'of the two' takes definite article 'the'.

questions.question: ______ higher you climb, the colder it gets.
questions.explanation: Parallel comparative structure ('The higher..., the colder...') requires 'The'.

questions.question: ______ richer you become, the more you desire.
questions.explanation: Double comparative construction requires 'The'.

questions.question: He is ______ Newton of modern physics.
questions.explanation: Proper noun used as an epithet/comparative metaphor takes 'the'.

questions.question: I saw ______ one-eyed beggar on the road.
questions.explanation: 'One-eyed' starts with consonant glide /w/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: She holds ______ university degree.
questions.explanation: 'University' starts with consonant sound /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: It is ______ unique opportunity.
questions.explanation: 'Unique' begins with consonant sound /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: We stayed at ______ hotel in the city.
questions.explanation: 'Hotel' begins with voiced consonant /h/, taking 'a' in modern English.

questions.question: It was ______ historical event.
questions.explanation: In modern standard English, 'historical' takes 'a'.

questions.question: He is ______ NCC cadet.
questions.explanation: 'NCC' begins with vowel sound /en/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: She is ______ X-ray technician.
questions.explanation: 'X-ray' begins with vowel sound /eks/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: He received ______ SOS message.
questions.explanation: 'SOS' begins with vowel sound /es/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: This is ______ uniform dress.
questions.explanation: 'Uniform' begins with consonant sound /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: It was ______ unanimous decision.
questions.explanation: 'Unanimous' begins with consonant sound /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: English is ______ universal language.
questions.explanation: 'Universal' begins with consonant sound /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: He returned after ______ hour.
questions.explanation: 'Hour' has silent 'h', taking 'an'.

questions.question: He bought ______ ewe from the farm.
questions.explanation: 'Ewe' (female sheep) is pronounced /juː/ (like 'you'), taking 'a'.

questions.question: She is ______ untidy girl.
questions.explanation: 'Untidy' begins with vowel sound /ʌn/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: He gave me ______ useful piece of advice.
questions.explanation: 'Useful' begins with consonant glide /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: ______ Arabian Sea lies to the west of India.
questions.explanation: Names of seas take 'The' ('The Arabian Sea').

questions.question: ______ Indian Ocean is named after India.
questions.explanation: Names of oceans take 'The'.

questions.question: ______ Red Sea connects the Mediterranean to the Indian Ocean.
questions.explanation: Names of seas take 'The'.

questions.question: ______ Persian Gulf is rich in oil.
questions.explanation: Names of gulfs take 'The' ('The Persian Gulf').

questions.question: He traveled across ______ Bay of Bengal.
questions.explanation: Names of bays take 'the' ('the Bay of Bengal').

questions.question: The ship sailed through ______ Suez Canal.
questions.explanation: Canals take definite article 'the' ('the Suez Canal').

questions.question: ______ Panama Canal links the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
questions.explanation: Canals take 'The'.

questions.question: ______ Times of India is widely circulated.
questions.explanation: Newspapers take definite article 'The'.

questions.question: I saw ______ moon shining brightly.
questions.explanation: The moon is a unique celestial body, taking 'the'.

questions.question: Look at ______ sky above.
questions.explanation: 'Sky' takes definite article 'the'.

questions.question: He was ______ first man to land on the moon.
questions.explanation: Ordinal numbers take 'the' ('the first man').

questions.question: Who is ______ second boy in the row?
questions.explanation: Ordinal numbers take 'the'.

questions.question: He lives on ______ third floor.
questions.explanation: Ordinal numbers take 'the'.

questions.question: This is ______ same pen that I lost.
questions.explanation: 'Same' is preceded by 'the' ('the same pen').

questions.question: ______ Titanic sank in 1912.
questions.explanation: Names of famous ships take 'The' ('The Titanic').

questions.question: ______ Rajdhani Express is a fast train.
questions.explanation: Names of trains take 'The' ('The Rajdhani Express').

questions.question: He can speak ______ French fluently.
questions.explanation: Names of languages take NO article ('speak French').

questions.question: ______ French defeated the Germans.
questions.explanation: When 'The' is placed before language name, it means the people of that country ('The French' = French people).

questions.question: He is learning ______ English.
questions.explanation: Languages take no article.

questions.question: ______ English ruled India for many years.
questions.explanation: 'The English' refers to the English people.

questions.question: Platinum is ______ rare metal.
questions.explanation: Countable descriptor takes 'a rare metal'.

questions.question: ______ water in this well is contaminated.
questions.explanation: Particularized uncountable noun takes 'The'.

questions.question: He died of ______ cholera.
questions.explanation: Names of diseases take no article ('died of cholera').

questions.question: She plays ______ cricket every evening.
questions.explanation: Names of sports take no article ('plays cricket').

questions.question: He is fond of ______ football.
questions.explanation: Sports take no article.

questions.question: ______ gold of South Africa is famous.
questions.explanation: Particularized material noun takes 'The'.

questions.question: ______ wisdom of Solomon is legendary.
questions.explanation: Particularized abstract noun takes 'The'.

questions.question: He is ______ MLA representing our constituency.
questions.explanation: 'MLA' starts with vowel sound /em/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: She gave me ______ one-rupee note.
questions.explanation: 'One-rupee' starts with consonant sound /w/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: He is ______ European professor.
questions.explanation: 'European' starts with consonant sound /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: I met ______ university lecturer.
questions.explanation: 'University' starts with consonant sound /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: It was ______ unanimous resolution.
questions.explanation: 'Unanimous' takes 'a'.

questions.question: He is ______ honest police officer.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' has silent 'h', taking 'an'.

questions.question: She joined ______ union of workers.
questions.explanation: 'Union' starts with consonant sound /j/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: He is ______ honorary member.
questions.explanation: 'Honorary' has silent 'h', taking 'an'.

questions.question: The thief was sent to ______ prison.
questions.explanation: Prison for punishment takes no article.

questions.question: He went to ______ hospital to visit a sick friend.
questions.explanation: Secondary visit takes 'the'.

questions.question: Children should go to ______ school regularly.
questions.explanation: Primary educational purpose takes no article.

questions.question: The parent went to ______ school to meet the headmaster.
questions.explanation: Secondary purpose takes 'the'.

questions.question: We should help ______ needy.
questions.explanation: 'The + adjective' indicates the whole group ('the needy' = all needy people).

questions.question: He is ______ university student.
questions.explanation: 'University' begins with a consonant sound /juː/, requiring article 'a'.

questions.question: She is ______ European citizen.
questions.explanation: 'European' begins with consonant sound /juː/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: Copper is ______ useful metal.
questions.explanation: 'Useful' begins with consonant sound /juː/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: He has ______ unique talent for painting.
questions.explanation: 'Unique' begins with consonant sound /juː/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: They formed ______ union of workers.
questions.explanation: 'Union' begins with consonant sound /juː/, taking 'a'.

questions.question: He is ______ heir to a vast fortune.
questions.explanation: 'Heir' has a silent 'h' and begins with vowel sound /ɛə/, taking 'an'.

questions.question: She is ______ honorable woman.
questions.explanation: 'Honorable' has a silent 'h', taking 'an'.

questions.question: He waited for ______ hour.
questions.explanation: 'Hour' has silent 'h', taking 'an'.

questions.question: It was ______ historic occasion.
questions.explanation: In modern standard English, 'historic' takes 'a'.

questions.question: He is ______ honest man.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' has silent 'h', taking 'an'.

questions.question: He is ______ MLA from our constituency.
questions.explanation: Initial letter 'M' is pronounced with vowel sound /ɛm/, taking 'an MLA'.

questions.question: She is ______ MP representing Wayanad.
questions.explanation: Letter 'M' begins with vowel sound, taking 'an MP'.

questions.question: He filed ______ FIR at the police station.
questions.explanation: Letter 'F' is pronounced /ɛf/, taking 'an FIR'.

questions.question: He is ______ IAS officer.
questions.explanation: Letter 'I' begins with vowel sound, taking 'an IAS officer'.

questions.question: She underwent ______ X-ray examination.
questions.explanation: Letter 'X' is pronounced /ɛks/, taking 'an X-ray'.

questions.question: He is ______ NCC cadet.
questions.explanation: Letter 'N' is pronounced /ɛn/, taking 'an NCC cadet'.

questions.question: She sent ______ SOS message during the storm.
questions.explanation: Letter 'S' is pronounced /ɛs/, taking 'an SOS'.

questions.question: He is ______ RTC conductor.
questions.explanation: Letter 'R' is pronounced /ɑːr/, taking 'an RTC'.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ______ highest peak in the world.
questions.explanation: Superlative adjectives take definite article 'the'.

questions.question: Pacific Ocean is ______ deepest ocean.
questions.explanation: Names of oceans take 'The'.

questions.question: ______ Nile is the longest river in the world.
questions.explanation: Names of rivers take 'The'.

questions.question: ______ Himalayas protect India from cold winds.
questions.explanation: Mountain ranges in plural take 'The'.

questions.question: Mount Abu is ______ sacred hill in Rajasthan.
questions.explanation: Individual peaks (not ranges) do not take 'the'; here 'a sacred hill'.

questions.question: We stayed at ______ Taj Hotel in Mumbai.
questions.explanation: Names of famous hotels take 'the'.

questions.question: ______ French is a beautiful language.
questions.explanation: Names of languages without the word 'language' take no article.

questions.question: ______ French defeated the Germans.
questions.explanation: 'The French' refers to the people/nation of France, requiring 'The'.

questions.question: He speaks ______ English very fluently.
questions.explanation: Language names take no article: 'speaks English'.

questions.question: ______ English ruled India for centuries.
questions.explanation: 'The English' refers to the British people.

questions.question: Gold is ______ precious metal.
questions.explanation: Uncountable material noun 'Gold' takes no article in general sense; 'a precious metal'.

questions.question: ______ gold of Kolar is famous.
questions.explanation: Specific material noun defined by phrase 'of Kolar' takes 'The'.

questions.question: Man is ______ mortal.
questions.explanation: 'Man' representing all humanity takes no article.

questions.question: ______ dog is a faithful animal.
questions.explanation: Singular countable noun used to represent the whole species takes 'The'.

questions.question: He plays ______ violin every evening.
questions.explanation: Names of musical instruments take definite article 'the'.

questions.question: She is fond of playing ______ flute.
questions.explanation: Musical instruments take 'the'.

questions.question: He plays ______ cricket very well.
questions.explanation: Names of games and sports take no article.

questions.question: They had ______ lunch at 1 PM.
questions.explanation: Regular meals take no article in general sense.

questions.question: We attended ______ grand dinner hosted by the Mayor.
questions.explanation: A meal preceded by an adjective or special occasion takes 'a/the'.

questions.question: He goes to ______ church every Sunday to pray.
questions.explanation: Places like school, church, hospital visited for primary purpose take no article.

questions.question: The bishop visited ______ church to inspect repairs.
questions.explanation: Visited for secondary purpose other than worship takes 'the'.

questions.question: The injured were rushed to ______ hospital.
questions.explanation: Hospital for treatment takes no article.

questions.question: He went to ______ hospital to visit his sick friend.
questions.explanation: Hospital for visiting takes 'the'.

questions.question: The criminal was sent to ______ prison.
questions.explanation: Prison for punishment takes no article.

questions.question: He was appointed ______ Chairman of the committee.
questions.explanation: Factitive object/unique post titles after 'appointed/elected' take no article.

questions.question: They elected him ______ President.
questions.explanation: Unique public office following 'elected' takes no article.

questions.question: He reads ______ Hindu newspaper every morning.
questions.explanation: Names of newspapers take definite article 'The'.

questions.question: ______ Ramayana is an ancient Indian epic.
questions.explanation: Holy scriptures take definite article 'The'.

questions.question: Valmiki's ______ Ramayana is a literary masterpiece.
questions.explanation: When author's name in genitive case precedes the scripture, 'the' is omitted.

questions.question: Kalidasa is ______ Shakespeare of India.
questions.explanation: Proper noun used as a metaphor/standard of comparison takes 'the'.

questions.question: Ahmedabad is ______ Manchester of India.
questions.explanation: Comparative proper noun takes 'the'.

questions.question: He is ______ Newton of our generation.
questions.explanation: Proper noun used as a comparative standard takes 'the'.
